title: Sawtooth Range
summary: Three days waiting for one clear sunrise over the ridge line.

entries.title: Arrival — fog rolls in early
entries.body: Hiked in expecting a two-night stay. Fog held the ridge hostage by early afternoon.

entries.title: Second morning, same fog
entries.body: No change overnight. Used the day to scout a lower vantage point as backup.

entries.title: Clear break at last light
entries.body: Broke clear on the third morning. Worth every hour of waiting — this is where the ridge-line shot came from.

photos.caption: Camp, right before the fog broke

title: West Coast Sound
summary: The fog never lifted, so I shot the fog instead.

entries.title: Fjord in fog
entries.body: Some mornings the plan has to change with the weather. Leaned into the low visibility instead of fighting it.

entries.title: Last morning, brief clearing
entries.body: Fog thinned for about twenty minutes right at sunrise. Got one clean frame before it closed back in.

title: Red Rock Canyon
summary: Scouted a new canyon route for the fall shoulder season.

entries.title: New access trail
entries.body: Found a route that puts the east wall in direct light about 40 minutes earlier than the main trail.

entries.title: Test shoot on the new route
entries.body: Confirmed the timing works. Planning to come back in October when the light angle is better.
